summary.text: Dark Capital Strength Biao is an immortal killer move Hei Lou Lan names against Liu Chang.

claims.text: After Liu Chang’s Bedazzlement hits Hei Lou Lan in Northern Plains, her vision turns white and she can no longer see. She closes her eyes, then activates this killer move. A black tiger condenses into solid form. Liu Chang asks whether she is using this move again. Yin Wu Que says the dark gold tiger seems to have grown wings. Wu Guang does not see it clearly. The moment the totem black tiger condenses, it disappears. Liu Chang looks for it and wonders if it can hide itself. The giant dark gold tiger appears behind him. A swat sends him flying. The cause is speed, not a concealment method. That speed has already surpassed what Gu Immortals’ naked eyes can perceive. It is like a phantom, appearing and disappearing suddenly. Every time it appears, it sends Liu Chang flying. He falls into a passive position and has to put all his strength into maintaining defensive methods. A strike sends him flying to the ground. Dust clouds rise, a deep crater forms, and Liu Chang remains unmoving, unconscious. After a Liu tribe elder restores Hei Lou Lan’s vision, she withdraws the dark capital strength biao which was beside Liu Chang. This totem killer move has gone through modifications. Its battle strength has surged, and it has already become her unique method.

Hei Lou Lan fights Chu Du on a nameless grassland, with Chu tribe immortals among the watchers. When Chu Du holds the complete advantage, she activates a totem killer move named dark capital strength biao. A tiger roars. Huge black claws send Chu Du flying. The giant black tiger flaps its wings, vanishes on the spot, and appears behind him. Chu Du defends and blocks the attack again, but the force still sends his body flying like a cannonball, crashing toward the ground. Someone shouts that this is Fairy Black Moon’s signature method. Chou Lao Wu sees it for the first time. He finds this totem killer move too convenient: it can stay dormant on the skin during normal times and be activated with a single thought when needed.

The dark capital strength biao is fast and hard to deal with in the first place. After Hei Lou Lan stabilizes her position and joins the fight again, she coordinates with it. They attack from the left and right and firmly suppress Chu Du. A shadow casts down from above him. It is the dark capital strength biao, which opens its mouth to bite. A strength path giant hand grabs it unguarded. It growls and struggles, then is slammed to the ground. Affected by Chu Du’s heaven and earth combined strength, its speed falls drastically and its threat plunges. At the next moment, it growls and jumps toward Hei Lou Lan. She advances instead of moving aside and enters its body in mid air. With a flash of dark light, it shrinks, turning into a half-beast half-man form, a layer of armor on her body that seems like smoke or an illusion. Combined with the totem, her battle strength surges. The biao wings flap and she instantly arrives before Chu Du. Then a huge vibration force is emitted and separates her from it. Its ferocity does not lower. It appears behind him and bites harshly. Hei Lou Lan wills to stop it, but it is not under her control. His killer move sends it flying. After he repels it, it returns. Hei Lou Lan regains control. It is heavily damaged and goes back onto her skin.
